_notes: Sheet 176 of the tournament savegame (8x4), read card by card from the image on 2026-11-08. CardID = 17600 + idx; 345 = character card (sheet 3, 10x7, index 45). The deck object of the save holds 31 cards: the 30 of the deck plus the character card, which is why the catalog says card_count 31 and card_ids [345, 17629]. Golden Bat's deck is sheet 176 like Medusa's, the four turtles', Doctor Strange's, Bigfoot's, Daredevil's, Luke Cage's and Bullseye's: only deck.identity (data/tts/golden-bat.json) tells the decks apart (docs/card-identity.md).

Hero card (read from the image): GOLDEN BAT, MELEE, START HEALTH 18, MOVE 3; special ability THE FIRST SUPERHERO 'If you haven't taken a Maneuver action this turn, add +2 to the value of Golden Bat's attacks.' No sidekicks: unmatched-memory lists a sidekick (Daisy, flagged hasSidekicks false) that is not on the hero card nor in the savegame (one miniature GUID pair, both named Golden Bat); it is ignored. Every card carries the GOLDEN BAT band (none ANY): the restriction changes nothing while he has no sidekicks.

The ability is the HeroDef passive attack_bonus (n 2) with `unless: maneuver`: HeroDef.attack_bonuses drops it once the owner has taken a Maneuver action in the running turn (`fx.maneuvers`, counted by Game.maneuver and the session's Maneuver button). The bot's estimates (Game.attack_bonus) read the same thing.

Copies (xN printed on each card), type, value and boost match unmatched-memory for all 12 titles. Discrepancies (the real card wins): A Punch To Shake The Earth says 'each opposing fighter in your zone' where unmatched-memory has 'in Golden Bat's zone'; Skirmish says 'move one of the fighters in the combat up to 2 spaces' where unmatched-memory has 'choose one of the fighters in the combat and move them up to 2 spaces' (the same thing).
